 I'm Game OTT release date confirmed: When and where will Dulquer Salmaan starrer Malayalam action-thriller stream
 SECTIONS I'm Game OTT release date confirmed: When and where will Dulquer Salmaan starrer Malayalam action-thriller stream By ET Entertainment Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Oct 31, 2026, 05:47:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Dulquer Salmaan's Malayalam fantasy action thriller I'm Game is set for its OTT premiere soon. Directed by Nahas Hidhayath, the film follows Dan John, a wealthy gambler whose life takes an unexpected turn after a hand transplant connects him to the consciousness of a deceased cricketer. The film also stars Antony Varghese, Kayadu Lohar, Mysskin, Kathir and Vinay Forrt.
 Dulquer Salmaan's I'm Game OTT release details
 Dulquer Salmaan's action thriller I'm Game, which brought together an unusual mix of fantasy, cricket and action, is preparing for its digital premiere. After arriving in cinemas in September, the Malayalam film is now set to make its OTT debut, giving viewers another opportunity to watch the big-budget entertainer.
 I'm Game OTT release
JioHotstar has confirmed that I'm Game will begin streaming on November 6, 2026. The film will be available in five languages including Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and Kannada. Its theatrical release took place on September 3, making the digital premiere approximately two months after its arrival in cinemas.
The streaming announcement was shared by the platform on social media with the tagline, "The game is about to begin!" 
— JioHotstarMal (@JioHotstarMal) What is I'm Game about?
Directed by Nahas Hidhayath , I’m Game is about Dan John (Dulquer Salmaan), a rich but irresponsible man, whose desire to earn quick money lands him in trouble. He has a gambling addiction especially with high stake cricket betting which accumulates him debts and jeopardizes his personal life.
But his life takes a bizarre turn when he is involved in a serious road accident. Dan loses one of his arms and gets a hand transplant. Soon he discovers that his new hand seems to have a mind of its own.
 It was the hand of Vicky, a great cricketer who had died under mysterious circumstances. With Vicky's consciousness seemingly connected to it, Dan finds himself pulled into a dangerous conflict involving Toni, a powerful figure controlling a cricket network.
 Kayadu Lohar plays Isha, a physiotherapist who helps Dan understand his unusual condition. What follows combines action, supernatural elements and a story of revenge.
 Dulquer Salmaan starrer features an ensemble cast
Apart from Dulquer, the film features Antony Varghese as Vignesh, also known as Vicky Das, while Mysskin plays the antagonist David Abraham. The cast also includes Kathir, Vinay Forrt, Samyuktha Viswanathan and Parth Tiwari.
The film marks Mysskin's acting debut in Malayalam cinema. It is directed by Nahas Hidhayath, who previously helmed the 2023 Malayalam action film RDX: Robert Dony Xavier.
Dulquer Salmaan and Jom Varghese have produced the project under the Wayfarer Films banner. The screenplay was written by Sajeer Baba, Ismail Aboobacker and Bilal Moidu, while Jakes Bejoy composed the music. Jimshi Khalid handled cinematography and Chaman Chacko served as the editor.
